ambient: The hangers click, several rows back, in the shape of somebody following.
The wool becomes plastic becomes wool.
A child laughs, close, at exactly your height.
description: You're pushing through hanging coats the way you did as a child, and it has been going on a long time. Wool, then plastic, then wool. The hangers click above you like slow applause. There's a light ahead, at the same distance it was.
name: The Coats

looks: Every one of them belongs to somebody who's alive.
One of them is warm. Only one.
You go through the pockets. You find your own hands.
objects.name: the coats

looks: A doorway, at the same distance as before.
It isn't a light, it's a colour, and you have been calling it a light out of politeness.
It goes out. You keep going. It comes back on behind you.
objects.name: the light ahead

weather: It's warm in here, and getting warmer the further you go, and the warmth smells like a cupboard.
